role: The map item (Items.map / Items.filled_map, id 358): holds the MapData for a map damage value, updates it from the player's surroundings each tick, and renders nothing itself.
scope_reason: world.conf maps = off: an empty map stays empty and a filled map from loot never draws, on the oracle side too (WorldConf gates the update path).

members.name: ItemMap
members.note: row 358 (filled_map, hasSubtypes); the empty map shares the class

members.name: getMapData
members.note: the native world has no map storage; RecipesMapExtending's port reads a no-data hook instead (crafting.c:map_extend_matches)

members.name: onCreated
members.note: SlotCrafting.onCrafting's native port treats Item.onCreated as a no-op for every item without a map (container.c:craft_out_crafted)

notes: Switched off with the rest of the map feature; the crafting recipes that reference the map item (map cloning, map extending) are still matched natively by crafting.c because the gate replays every recipe class.
